sources.label: morphe patches for ipusnas
sources.author: iPusnas
patch_list: Makes the PairIP license check pass for sideloaded installs so the app no longer redirects to the Play Store and closes.
Disables Google Firebase Analytics tracking and removes Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications.
Stops the app from reporting security breaches or APK integrity failures to the developers' Telegram channel.
Removes the hard-coded OkHttp certificate pins and SSL pinning interceptor so the app trusts system and user CAs.
Disables the FLAG_SECURE window flag in the PDF and EPUB readers so screenshots and screen recordings are allowed.
Adds a menu option that downloads, decrypts, and saves the book as a readable PDF or EPUB in the public Downloads folder.
